findings.summary: Current implementation is qualified as a discrete daily model, not a generic delt integrator.
DVS_Partitioning_N documentation describes N stress while implementation modifier uses RFTRA.
Water and N uptake use different implicit spatial root activity assumptions.
Daily operator ordering determines competition among uptake, reactions and transport.
Unbounded advective export can exceed a finite NH4/NO3 pool; production transport now limits donor export and preserves internal transfer mass.
Crop N balance is checked in calc_rates before same-day rates are integrated, so it verifies the prior integrated state and may not independently check the terminal crop-day update.

Existing assimilation test constructs a driver without TMIN although current assimilation implementation requires drv.TMIN; audit CI isolates this stale harness rather than treating it as a model regression.

Requested leaf/stem reallocation is capped against a fixed start-of-reallocation quota, not same-day surviving donor biomass. Leaf integration removes nothing when REALLOC_LV >= post-senescence leaf biomass; stem integration can drive WST negative, while storage organs are still credited from requested REALLOC_SO. A transactional donor-limited repair is required.

Crop-N balance raises only at absolute checksum >= 1 kg N/ha; smaller systematic daily bookkeeping errors can pass. Qualification suite should use tighter process-level invariants even if production tolerance remains unchanged.

Direct unittest module discovery incorrectly instantiates WofostTestingTemplate and pandas 3 breaks label-based Series[0] access. Regression envelope now invokes the module's canonical suite() and uses iloc[0].
